items.title: ‘Non-answers’ aren’t working. This is what investors really need from the Fed.
items.sum: What really matters to investors, economists say, is for Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh to prove he can successfully communicate the central bank’s strategy.

items.sum: Ukraine says restrictions on Starlink and Starshield have been lifted, restoring connectivity to fast-moving military systems after disruptions.

items.title: AI fever ignites a boom in thematic ETFs as fund managers hunt for their next big hit
items.sum: The runaway success of the artificial-intelligence trade has left investors hungry for the next big market theme. Wall Street fund managers are happily obliging with a flurry of new targeted products, helping investors invest in everything from the rise of robotics to the incipient space economy.

items.title: Silicon Valley Democrats demand investigation into Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
items.sum: A letter demanding an investigation indicates Democrats will make investigating Starlink's interruption a top priority if they win control of the U.S. House.

items.title: Do machines have feelings? AI has philosophers and tech leaders rethinking consciousness.
items.sum: As AI models become more advanced, tech leaders and philosophers are mulling the relationship between humanity and technology.
